notes: Remote MCP URL is region-specific (https://mcp.<region>.keboola.com/mcp, e.g. mcp.eu-central-1.keboola.com); a local server is available from github.com/keboola/mcp-server. Jobs consume the monthly compute minutes; inactive accounts out of credits are suspended after 2 months. Developer docs: https://developers.keboola.com/.

name: Make API / MCP
free_tier: free tier: 1,000 operations/mo; most REST API endpoints require a paid plan
desc_en: Trigger and manage Make automation scenarios, or call MCP tools, via REST API and a native MCP server/client.
desc_pl: Uruchamia i zarządza scenariuszami automatyzacji Make oraz wywołuje narzędzia MCP przez REST API i natywny serwer/klient MCP.
notes: MCP Server and MCP Client are included free on all Make plans; you pay only for operations consumed when scenarios run. Most REST API endpoints are reserved for paid subscriptions.

name: Merge (Agent Handler)
free_tier: free tier: 2,000 monthly credits for evaluation; production usage needs a paid Starter/Business/Enterprise plan
desc_en: Give an agent governed, audited tool access to Salesforce, Slack, Jira and 100+ enterprise apps via API or MCP.
desc_pl: Daje agentowi kontrolowany, audytowany dostęp do narzędzi Salesforce, Slack, Jira i ponad 100 aplikacji firmowych przez API lub MCP.
notes: Separate product from Merge's classic Unified API (HRIS/ATS/CRM sync); Agent Handler is the AI-agent-facing tool-calling layer. Paid tier starts around $650/mo for 10 linked accounts, then per-account pricing.

name: n8n API
free_tier: free, self-hosted (open source, unlimited); n8n Cloud offers a paid-plan trial
desc_en: Create, run and monitor n8n workflows via REST API, and expose or consume tools through MCP trigger/client nodes.
desc_pl: Tworzy, uruchamia i monitoruje przepływy pracy n8n przez REST API oraz udostępnia lub wykorzystuje narzędzia przez węzły MCP.
notes: REST API manages workflows/executions/credentials/users, not per-node business logic. MCP support is a first-party node (MCP Server Trigger / MCP Client Tool) inside a running n8n instance, not a single hosted vendor endpoint. Non-Enterprise API keys have full account access; scoped keys need Enterprise plan.

name: Nango
free_tier: free tier: 10 connections, 10 compute hours, 10GB data transfer/mo
desc_en: Authorize end users to 400+ third-party APIs/MCP servers and proxy authenticated calls to them from your app or agent.
desc_pl: Autoryzuje użytkowników do ponad 400 zewnętrznych API/serwerów MCP i przekazuje uwierzytelnione wywołania z aplikacji lub agenta.
notes: Nango is primarily an auth/proxy broker (open source, self-hostable) rather than itself an MCP server; its 'MCP Auth' feature lets your app authorize users to OTHER vendors' MCP servers (Notion, HubSpot, etc.) and call them via Nango's proxy. Free self-hosting is not offered outside the Enterprise (BYOC) plan.

name: Paragon ActionKit
auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <token>; connected accounts use managed OAuth
free_tier: free experimentation tier with self-serve keys; production/scale pricing is usage-based or contract
desc_en: Call thousands of pre-built Tools and Triggers across 130+ SaaS apps (Slack, Salesforce, Gmail) via API or MCP.
desc_pl: Wywołuje tysiące gotowych narzędzi i wyzwalaczy w ponad 130 aplikacjach SaaS (Slack, Salesforce, Gmail) przez API lub MCP.
notes: ActionKit specifically has a self-serve free tier for experimentation; Paragon's broader embedded-iPaaS platform is contract/sales-only with no public self-serve tier. ActionKit MCP uses SSE transport and is listed on the Anthropic MCP registry.

name: Pipedream Connect
free_tier: check pricing (pipedream.com/pricing) for current Connect free-tier request/credit limits
desc_en: Call 2,700+ app APIs and run managed-auth actions on end users' behalf via REST API or Pipedream MCP servers.
desc_pl: Wywołuje API ponad 2700 aplikacji i wykonuje akcje w imieniu użytkowników przez REST API lub serwery MCP Pipedream.
notes: Requires a Pipedream project plus client ID/secret/project ID to call the MCP server; managed auth handles end-user OAuth for connected apps.

name: StackOne
free_tier: free tier: 1,000 action-call credits/seat/mo (Starter), no credit card required
desc_en: Call 500+ SaaS integrations (HRIS, ATS, CRM, documents) through one unified API or MCP gateway covering 27,000+ actions.
desc_pl: Wywołuje ponad 500 integracji SaaS (HRIS, ATS, CRM, dokumenty) przez jedno ujednolicone API lub bramę MCP z ponad 27 000 akcji.
notes: Beyond the free 1,000 credits/seat, Starter bills $0.003/extra call; Core and Enterprise tiers are quote-based (contact sales).

name: Superglue
auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <api_key> (exact header not independently confirmed - verify in docs)
free_tier: free tier: Pro plan free to start, 3,000 executions/mo and 5M tokens/mo included, self-serve signup
desc_en: Connect and orchestrate enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, databases) through a self-serve API and per-integration MCP servers.
desc_pl: Łączy i orkiestruje systemy korporacyjne (ERP, CRM, bazy danych) przez samoobsługowe API i dedykowane serwery MCP.
notes: Added: open-source, self-serve integration/migration agent for enterprise systems (NetSuite, SAP, Sage Intacct, Dynamics) with per-app MCP servers; some exact API details (auth header, SDK) could not be independently confirmed in this pass and should be double-checked in the live docs before use.

name: Zapier MCP / AI Actions
auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <connection_token> (OAuth auto-configured for listed clients like Claude/ChatGPT)
free_tier: Zapier Free plan (100 tasks/mo) covers MCP tool calls; more on paid plans
desc_en: Call 9,000+ apps and 40,000+ pre-built actions (Slack, Gmail, Sheets, etc.) through one MCP endpoint.
desc_pl: Wywołuje ponad 9000 aplikacji i 40 000 gotowych akcji (Slack, Gmail, Arkusze itd.) przez jeden endpoint MCP.
notes: "AI Actions"/Natural Language Actions is deprecated; Zapier now steers agents to Zapier MCP. Tool calls consume the same 'tasks' quota as regular Zaps.

name: Anthropic Claude API
free_tier: paid only
desc_en: Send messages to Claude models for text and vision generation, tool use, batch jobs and document analysis.
desc_pl: Wysyłaj wiadomości do modeli Claude, by generować tekst, analizować obrazy i dokumenty, używać narzędzi i przetwarzać wsadowo.
notes: docs.anthropic.com and docs.claude.com redirect to platform.claude.com. Rate limits depend on usage tier. The API's MCP connector lets Claude call remote MCP servers; there is no MCP server that wraps the API itself.

name: Cohere API
free_tier: free trial key: 1,000 calls/mo, rate-limited
desc_en: Call chat, embed, rerank and classify endpoints for text generation, semantic search and RAG.
desc_pl: Wywołuj endpointy czatu, embeddingów, rerankingu i klasyfikacji do generowania tekstu, wyszukiwania semantycznego i RAG.
notes: Official MCP server only searches documentation. Trial keys are not for production use. v2 API is current; v1 is legacy.

name: Comet Opik Cloud API
auth_hint: Headers 'authorization: <OPIK_API_KEY>' (no Bearer prefix) and 'Comet-Workspace: <WORKSPACE>'; remote MCP uses browser sign-in
free_tier: Free cloud plan: 25k spans/month, 60-day data retention, up to 10 team members
desc_en: Lets an agent log and read LLM traces and spans, score them with evaluations and manage datasets and prompts in Opik.
desc_pl: Pozwala agentowi zapisywać i odczytywać ślady oraz spany wywołań LLM, oceniać je ewaluacjami i zarządzać zbiorami danych oraz promptami w Opik.
notes: REST base https://www.comet.com/opik/api/v1/private/. Remote MCP needs OAuth browser sign-in; local: uvx opik mcp configure.

name: DeepSeek API
free_tier: paid only
desc_en: Send chat and reasoning requests to DeepSeek models via an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible REST API.
desc_pl: Wysyłaj zapytania czatu i rozumowania do modeli DeepSeek przez REST API zgodne z OpenAI i Anthropic.
notes: No native SDK: use the OpenAI SDK (base_url https://api.deepseek.com) or the Anthropic SDK (https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic). Off-peak hours (UTC) are discounted.

name: fal.ai
free_tier: check pricing
desc_en: Generate images, video, audio and 3D with 1,000+ hosted models via queued REST or real-time WebSocket.
desc_pl: Generuj obrazy, wideo, audio i 3D ponad 1000 hostowanymi modelami przez kolejkowe REST lub WebSocket w czasie rzeczywistym.
notes: The auth header prefix is 'Key', not 'Bearer'. The MCP server accepts an API key or OAuth. Long jobs use the queue API (submit, status, result).

name: Fireworks AI
free_tier: trial credits: $1 on signup
desc_en: Run serverless or dedicated inference and fine-tuning for open models via OpenAI-compatible APIs.
desc_pl: Uruchamiaj bezserwerowe lub dedykowane wnioskowanie i fine-tuning otwartych modeli przez API zgodne z OpenAI.
notes: Official MCP server only searches documentation. The Responses API can call external MCP servers as tools.

name: Google Gemini API
free_tier: free tier: rate-limited access to Flash/Pro models
desc_en: Generate text and images, analyze multimodal input (video, audio, PDFs), and run code execution with Gemini models.
desc_pl: Generuj tekst i obrazy, analizuj dane multimodalne (wideo, audio, PDF) i uruchamiaj wykonywanie kodu modelami Gemini.
notes: Official MCP server only searches documentation; it does not run inference. Free-tier content may be used to improve Google products. Google is replacing standard API keys with authorization keys; unrestricted standard keys are rejected in 2026, so use a current key type. Google publishes a Discovery document, not an OpenAPI spec.

name: Groq API
free_tier: free tier: rate-limited per model, no card
desc_en: Run fast LLM chat, tool use and speech-to-text on hosted open models via an OpenAI-compatible API.
desc_pl: Uruchamiaj szybki czat LLM, wywołania narzędzi i transkrypcję mowy na hostowanych otwartych modelach przez API zgodne z OpenAI.
notes: Free-tier limits vary by model (e.g. 30 RPM / 1K RPD); see console.groq.com/settings/limits. Not to be confused with xAI Grok.

name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
free_tier: free tier: monthly credits (more with PRO)
desc_en: Call hundreds of open-weight chat, vision, image, video and audio models across many providers with one HF token.
desc_pl: Wywołuj setki otwartych modeli czatu, wizji, obrazu, wideo i audio u wielu dostawców jednym tokenem HF.
notes: The OpenAI-compatible endpoint (router.huggingface.co/v1) handles chat only; use InferenceClient for other tasks. The token needs the 'Make calls to Inference Providers' scope. Pick a provider with a model suffix such as :fastest or :cheapest.

name: Mistral AI API
free_tier: free tier: Studio free mode, rate-limited
desc_en: Run chat completions, embeddings, OCR and document processing with Mistral models via REST.
desc_pl: Wykonuj uzupełnienia czatu, embeddingi, OCR i przetwarzanie dokumentów modelami Mistral przez REST.
notes: Official MCP (same API key) currently exposes only Studio Skills management tools, not chat inference; call the REST API for inference.

name: OpenAI API
free_tier: paid only
desc_en: Generate text, images, audio and embeddings, and run tool-calling via the Responses and Chat Completions APIs.
desc_pl: Generuj tekst, obrazy, audio i embeddingi oraz wywołuj narzędzia przez API Responses i Chat Completions.
notes: Docs moved from platform.openai.com to developers.openai.com (old URLs redirect). Usage-based billing with a payment method; rate limits scale with usage tier. OpenAI MCP docs cover building MCP servers for ChatGPT, not an MCP wrapping the API.

name: OpenRouter
free_tier: free models: 50 req/day (1,000/day after $10 purchase)
desc_en: Route chat requests to hundreds of LLMs from many providers through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint with fallback.
desc_pl: Kieruj zapytania czatu do setek modeli LLM od wielu dostawców przez jeden endpoint zgodny z OpenAI, z fallbackiem.
notes: The official remote MCP server uses OAuth PKCE and mints a 7-day key with a $10 default spend limit. It includes send-message and generate-image tools. OAuth PKCE is also available for apps.

name: PiAPI
free_tier: trial credits: $0.50 on signup
desc_en: Generate images, video and music through one API proxying Midjourney, Flux, Kling and other models.
desc_pl: Generuj obrazy, wideo i muzykę przez jedno API pośredniczące w dostępie do Midjourney, Flux, Kling i innych modeli.
notes: Third-party reseller, not the model owner. The Midjourney access is unofficial, so it can break or violate Midjourney's terms of service. Tasks are async (create task, then poll or webhook).

name: Replicate
free_tier: paid only
desc_en: Run thousands of hosted image, video, audio and text models via HTTP predictions; also fine-tune and deploy.
desc_pl: Uruchamiaj tysiące hostowanych modeli obrazu, wideo, audio i tekstu przez predykcje HTTP; także dostrajaj i wdrażaj.
notes: Billed per second of compute or per output. The MCP server is also available locally via npx replicate-mcp.

name: Together AI
free_tier: check pricing
desc_en: Run serverless inference, batch jobs, fine-tuning and dedicated GPU endpoints for open-source models.
desc_pl: Uruchamiaj bezserwerowe wnioskowanie, zadania wsadowe, fine-tuning i dedykowane endpointy GPU dla otwartych modeli.
notes: Official MCP server only searches documentation. The API is OpenAI-compatible.

name: Vercel AI Gateway
free_tier: free tier: monthly credits on subset of models
desc_en: Send chat, image, embedding and rerank requests to 100+ models through one gateway with failover and spend tracking.
desc_pl: Wysyłaj zapytania czatu, obrazów, embeddingów i rerankingu do ponad 100 modeli przez jedną bramkę z failoverem i kontrolą wydatków.
notes: The base URL https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh works with OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs. Vercel's MCP server is for the whole platform and does not run inference. Tokens have no markup. BYOK requires the paid tier. Free-tier overage returns 429. On Vercel, OIDC tokens can replace the API key.

name: Voyage AI (embeddings/rerank)
free_tier: free tier: 200M tokens on current models
desc_en: Generate text, code and multimodal embeddings and rerank documents for RAG and semantic search.
desc_pl: Generuj embeddingi tekstu, kodu i multimodalne oraz reranking dokumentów na potrzeby RAG i wyszukiwania semantycznego.
notes: Owned by MongoDB, but the standalone API at api.voyageai.com is still self-serve. Free tokens do not apply to the Batch API.

name: xAI Grok API
free_tier: paid only (prepaid credits)
desc_en: Generate text, images, video and voice with Grok models, with built-in web search and code tools.
desc_pl: Generuj tekst, obrazy, wideo i mowę modelami Grok z wbudowanym wyszukiwaniem w sieci i narzędziami do kodu.
notes: The account must have prepaid credits (console.x.ai). The API is OpenAI-compatible (/v1/responses, /v1/chat/completions). Official MCP server only searches documentation.
